newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firm plans to buy 35,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firm plans to buy 35,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: A Philippine flour mill said on Wednesday it plans to open tenders for 35,000 tonnes of U.S. spring wheat for October delivery.
Traders said Philippine flour mills separately bought 21,100 tonnes of U.S. spring wheat on Tuesday night at an average of $196 per tonne.
"We are opening a tender later today for 35,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat," an executive in a local flour mill told Reuters.
Philippine flour mills bought 66,900 tonnes of spring and western white wheat last week, traders said.
